definitions.explanation: Indicates the highest degree of something. Somewhat literary or formal in tone. Often used with adjectives or adjectival nouns to intensify meaning.

examples.japanese: {至極|しごく}⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至極|しごく}もっともだ。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至極|しごく}⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧で⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく、⟦{聞|き}いている→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}した→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧。
examples.english: His explanation was extremely concise and easy to understand, and everyone listening was convinced.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal or literary intensifier. The most common collocation by far is {至極|しごく}⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧ (perfectly natural/obvious) and {至極|しごく}もっとも (entirely reasonable). Less commonly used than ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至極|しごく}⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧ (perfectly natural)
- {至極|しごく}もっとも (entirely reasonable)
- {至極|しごく}⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ (extremely simple)
- {至極|しごく}⟦{真|ま}っ{当|とう}→真っ当：15295_mattou⟧な (very proper/legitimate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely (standard formal intensifier)
- {極|きわ}めて: extremely (formal, written)
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (casual, everyday)
